content_zh:
“旁白害怕我丢掉你后剧情无法进展，还特别说明一下。”邢烨晃着镜子道，“所以接下来你应该没什么用了。”
镜子没什么反应，默默地显示着地图，像是一面正常镜子。
智商不低，至少在隐瞒身份这一点上十分敏感，每当邢烨试图试探镜子的真正身份时，它都能及时察觉话语中的陷阱，立刻变得安静起来。
邢烨对镜子说：“关于你的信息我知道的很少，目前可以确定的有两点：第一，你并非三位操纵者之一，他们也只当你是个听话的道具；第二，你无法反抗旁白的安排，不过一直在用闹小情绪的方式来表达自己的不满。我对你也只有一个问题，说我‘丑’是你自己的想法，还是闹脾气的表现。”
邢烨是真的有点在意这个问题，毕竟在他眼中弟弟邢烁是优秀且英俊的，他不愿意有谁说这张与邢烁相似的脸丑。
镜子诚实地回答道：一半一半，不算丑，没我好看。
“没有你好看？”邢烨微微挑眉，“所以你曾经是人，或者有人形？”
镜面顿时黯淡下去，同时闪现出“卑鄙”两个字。
邢烨没有生气，反而有些想笑。镜子像个有点脾气的小少爷，还挺可爱的。
小烁从小就乖得过分，父母死后更是不哭不闹，生怕自己诉苦会给哥哥带来麻烦。邢烨在刚撑起家业的时候的确没有时间关心弟弟，等有时间后，弟弟邢烁早就变成一个自主自立的人，遇事也不会与他商量。
他其实很希望邢烁是个任性的弟弟，偶尔向他发发脾气要点钱挥霍，自觉对弟弟有亏欠的邢烨会无条件满足他所有愿望。
邢烨一直紧绷的神经稍微柔软起来，他敲敲镜面：“有多好看？不是我自夸，我这张脸已经是明星级别了，比我好看的人很难找的。”
通过短暂的接触，邢烨已经了解到镜子在意容貌且有点小脾气的性格，这么一激将镜子果然受不了，立刻冒出来几个字：不要脸！
“那你倒是拿出证据来反驳我啊。”邢烨挑衅道。
镜面上出现一个人的轮廓，看样子是男性。
邢烨再想细看时轮廓却消失了，镜子写到：一个影子就能美死你，骗子，想套我的身份，我才不会上当呢！
邢烨说：“哦，镜子，性别男，对自己的外貌极度自信，甚至可以称之为自恋，根据其性格表现，年龄应该在20-25岁之间，没深入接触过社会。性格不够坦率，有点小聪明。未表现出对人类的不屑和隔阂，对我的称呼是骗子而非‘你们人类都是骗子’，本体为人类的可能性超过70%。究竟是这个世界的NPC被封印在镜子中还是另有奇遇有待考证。目前也只能看出这点信息，确实套不出多少身份。”
镜子：你是魔鬼吗！
镜子感觉自己再说几句话就会被套出所有信息，干脆黑了屏，无论邢烨怎么挑衅都不出来。
通过调戏镜子缓解了一下心情，邢烨暂时将想起弟弟的悲伤放在一边，静心思考剧情。

通过旁白提供的信息能够推测出克莱尔的另外两个结局之一——被女王抓到处死，另外旁白没有注意到，它透露出一个操纵者的关键信息，能够左右女王的想法。
女王是剧情重要人物，她不太可能是操纵者，太醒目太容易被看穿。
所以另外一个操纵者应该是女王比较亲密的人，贴身侍女或者侍卫，女性的话，容貌肯定一般，毁容的女王不可能喜欢年轻貌美的侍女。
刻意不去皇宫，操纵者大概会想尽办法逼他去，邢烨想了想，决定掌握主动，先去皇宫附近打探女王的情报，性格、喜好、民间传闻，尽可能多地收集情报，以便应对突发状况。
从伯爵的庄园逃出来时，邢烨拿了不少没有任何标记的金币和银币，应该就是这个国家的通用货币，方便行动。
他不清楚操纵者对自己的情况、位置能够了解到什么程度，但多做些准备总是没错的。
邢烨按照地图的标识，用半天时间赶往最近的市集，找人喂了马，并选了几件旅人穿的衣服。
在遇到女装时，他犹豫了一下，最终还是买下了两套普通的平民女装，以备不时之需。

镜子：哦。

"The narrator is afraid that the plot will not progress if I leave you, so I explain it specifically." Xing Ye shook the mirror and said, "So you will be useless from now on."
The mirror showed no reaction and silently displayed the map, like a normal mirror.
It has a high IQ, and is at least very sensitive when it comes to concealing its identity. Whenever Xing Ye tries to test the true identity of the mirror, it can detect the trap in its words in time and immediately becomes quiet.
Xing Ye said to the mirror: "I know very little information about you. There are two things that are certain at the moment: first, you are not one of the three manipulators, and they only regard you as an obedient prop; second, you cannot resist the narrator's arrangements, but you have been expressing your dissatisfaction in a petty way. I only have one question for you. Is it your own idea to call me 'ugly', or is it a sign of losing your temper?"
Xing Ye really cares about this issue. After all, in his eyes, his younger brother Xing Shuo is excellent and handsome. He doesn't want anyone to say that this face similar to Xing Shuo is ugly.
The mirror answered honestly: Half and half, not ugly, not as good-looking as me.
"Not as good-looking as you?" Xing Ye raised his eyebrows slightly, "So you were once a human, or had a human form?"
The mirror suddenly dimmed, and the word "despicable" flashed at the same time.
Xing Ye was not angry, but wanted to laugh. The mirror looks like a young master with a bit of a temper, which is quite cute.
Xiao Shuo has been extremely well-behaved since she was a child. She even refused to cry or make trouble after her parents died, for fear that complaining would bring trouble to her brother. When Xing Ye first raised the family business, he really didn't have time to care about his younger brother. When he had time, his younger brother Xing Shuo had long since become an independent person and would not discuss anything with him.
He actually hoped that Xing Shuo would be a willful younger brother who would occasionally lose his temper and ask for money to squander. Xing Ye, who felt he was indebted to his younger brother, would unconditionally grant all his wishes.
Xing Ye's tense nerves softened slightly. He knocked on the mirror and said, "How beautiful is it? I'm not boasting. My face is already at the level of a star. It's hard to find someone better looking than me."
Through a brief contact, Xing Ye has learned that Jing Jing cares about appearance and has a bit of a temper. After being so aroused, Jing Jing couldn't stand it, and a few words immediately popped up: Shameless!
"Then you should provide evidence to refute me." Xing Ye provoked.
The outline of a person appeared on the mirror. It looked like a man.
When Xing Ye tried to take a closer look, the outline disappeared, and the mirror wrote: A shadow can kill you, liar, trying to trick my identity, I won't be fooled!
Xing Ye said: "Oh, Mirror, male. He is extremely confident in his appearance. It can even be called narcissism. According to his personality, he should be between 20 and 25 years old. He has not been deeply exposed to society. His personality is not frank and he is a bit clever. He has not shown any disdain and disdain for human beings." There is a gap in calling me a liar instead of 'you humans are all liars'. The possibility of being human is more than 70%. Whether the NPC in this world is sealed in the mirror or there is another adventure needs to be verified. At present, this information can only be seen, and there is really not much identity. "
Mirror: Are you the devil!
Jing Jing felt that all the information would be taken out of him if he said a few words, so the screen simply went black, and no matter how provocative Xing Ye tried, nothing came out.
By teasing the mirror to ease his mood, Xing Ye temporarily put aside the sadness of thinking about his younger brother and thought about the plot quietly.
Through the information provided by the narrator, we can deduce one of Claire's other two endings - being caught and executed by the queen. In addition, the narrator did not notice that it revealed key information about a manipulator who could influence the queen's thoughts.
The Queen is an important figure in the plot. She is unlikely to be a manipulator. She is too conspicuous and easy to see through.
Therefore, the other manipulator should be someone close to the queen, a personal maid or bodyguard. If she is a woman,The appearance must be average, and it is impossible for a disfigured queen to like a young and beautiful maid.
If he deliberately did not go to the palace, the manipulator would probably try his best to force him to go. Xing Ye thought about it and decided to take the initiative. He first went to the palace to find out about the queen's personality, preferences, and folk rumors, and collected as much information as possible in order to deal with emergencies.
When escaping from the count's manor, Xing Ye took a lot of unmarked gold and silver coins, which should be the country's common currency to facilitate movement.
He didn't know how much the manipulator knew about his situation and location, but it was always a good idea to make more preparations.
Xing Ye followed the signs on the map and rushed to the nearest market in half a day. He found someone to feed the horse and selected some clothes for travelers.
When he encountered women's clothing, he hesitated, and finally bought two sets of ordinary civilian women's clothing for emergencies.
